meta.title: HAI VAN PASS  - The most scenic route in Vietnam
meta.description:
The Hải Vân Pass, is an approximately 21 km long mountain pass on National Route 1A in Vietnam. It traverses a spur of the larger Annamite Range that juts into the East Sea of Viet Nam, on the border of Đà Nẵng and Thừa Thiên–Huế Province

To experience the pass , we started our journey from Hue to Hoi an and stopped at multiple places. It was one of the most thrilling journey of our lives. Watch the video to experience more.
